summary: Verified bug fix for RTF element 404 error when editing deleted elements. The fix adds a pre-save check in handleAddRichTextToSlide to verify element existence before API call; if deleted, creates new element instead. Backend tests (13/13 passed) confirm PUT to deleted element returns 404, and POST creates new elements correctly. Frontend E2E tests confirm creating new RTF elements works with success toast 'Texto adicionado ao slide!'. No 404 errors detected during testing.

critical_code_review_comments: Bug fix correctly implemented: handleAddRichTextToSlide now checks elementExists before API call
The check uses: const elementExists = targetSlide?.elements?.some(e => e.id === editingHtmlElementId)
If element was deleted, creates new via addElement instead of updateElement
editingHtmlSlideId stores slideId when opening edit dialog to prevent stale reference

context_for_next_testing_agent: RTF element delete-then-save bug is FIXED. The fix in handleAddRichTextToSlide verifies element still exists before API call. If deleted, creates new element. Backend correctly returns 404 for updates to deleted elements. Key test IDs: sparkles icon button opens 'Criar Texto com IA' dialog, 'Adicionar ao Slide' button saves new elements, 'Salvar Alterações' button saves edits. Timeline shows 'Html 1', 'Html 2' etc for HTML elements.

bug_fix_verification.bug_description: Editing RTF text and clicking save gave 404 error because the element was deleted
bug_fix_verification.fix_description: handleAddRichTextToSlide now checks if element exists in currentProject.course.slides[].elements[] before calling updateElement API. If deleted, creates new element via addElement instead.
